messages:
Priya: Flagging a weird one from the node onboarding sample: when LOG_LEVEL=verbose + OTEL_ENABLED=true the request-id column is empty for some retries. Seen on mac and linux.
Dan: I saw this too in CI smoke. Only happens with our new async otel hook. Non-OTEL runs fine.
Omar: Quick theory: otelHook sets context asynchronously, then our logHook reads req.ctx synchronously. Race if request retries happen quickly.
Jess: Also noticed REDACT_SENSITIVE=true can sometimes remove the header entirely (not just mask it) during retry. Could be header normalization step clobbering it.
Priya: Repro steps: clone sampleapp, set LOG_LEVEL=verbose REDACT_SENSITIVE=true OTEL_ENABLED=1, start, then hammer endpoint with curl in a loop. Deterministic for me.
Dan: Minimal order-sensitive snippet:
```js
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').otelHook())
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').logHook())
```
Dan: If otelHook's promise hasn't resolved the logger prints empty reqId.
Omar: Short-term workaround: await telemetry.init() before mounting logHook in the sampleapp startup.
Jess: Filed an issue and a small PR with two options: make otel init sync-ish, or have logHook fallback to req.headers['x-request-id'] if ctx missing. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/210
telemetry-bot: Issue TW-5699 created: "node sdk: request-id missing with OTEL+verbose+retries" linked to PR #210.
Priya: Can we hold the hosted sampleapp rollout until we get a non-breaking fix? First-run UX matters.
Dan: I'll add a feature-flagged merge path and a changelog note. Thanks team.
